scope: Six targeted current-behavior probes; no live model, native CU, crash-kill, or competitive qualification.

results.observation: Accepted queued prompt absent from persisted snapshot and absent after restoration.
Resume error plus idle leaves ready=false and Continue undispatched; no manager timeout/failure transition.
Thread start/Resume after terminal failed lifecycle does not create an engine; stale reference remains.
Second same-folder writer dispatches immediately when stop returns, without a child-exit/drain acknowledgement. Real lingering-process overlap is not exercised here.
One actual storage write failure prevents later flushes even after the filesystem is repaired.
Real thread shell sandbox can read a synthetic sibling file outside its folder; it is a write boundary, not read confidentiality.
